data.sector: Developer productivity / AI agents for engineering
data.similarity_reason: US seed startup building an AI agent that routes code reviews and automates engineering-team work — direct comparable.

data.contact_evidence: AlleyCorp's official contact page (alleycorp.com/contact/) lists info@alleycorp.com as its public contact route.
data.evidence_summary: GeekWire, 2025-09-29: Actual AI announced a $3.2M seed round led by AlleyCorp for its engineering-manager agent that routes code reviews and automates team workflows.

data.similarity_reason: Greptile automates AI code review/validation of pull requests for engineering teams — directly comparable product and customer base.
data.partner_evidence: Greptile's Series B blog states Menlo Ventures led the round and Deedy Das (Menlo partner) is joining the board.

data.evidence_summary: Greptile announced a $50M Series B led by Menlo Ventures on 2026-10-19, with participation from Jump Trading, Wing, Operator Collective, Benchmark, YC, Browder Capital and Initialized; $750M valuation; Deedy Das joining the board.

data.similarity_reason: US seed-stage startup automating code reviews for engineering teams — direct product, customer and stage comparable.
data.investor_role: lead (round led by YC, VitalStage, Uncorrelated)

data.similarity_reason: Both are US developer-software startups selling to engineering leaders. Span's developer-intelligence platform tracks how engineers spend time and which AI code editors they use and detects AI-generated code (customers: Ramp, Vanta, Intercom, Braze); the target startup builds automated code review for engineering teams. Same buyer (CTOs/eng leaders), same software-development tooling category, both aiming at engineering efficiency and code quality.
data.partner_evidence: Upstarts names Craft Ventures' Brian Murray as the investor in Span's Series A, saying he sees Span helping companies bifurcate spend on salary versus tokens.
data.evidence_summary: Span (Attuned Inc.), San Francisco, announced 2025-11-17 that it raised $25M in combined Seed and Series A funding. Investors: Craft Ventures (Series A lead), Alt Capital, SV Angel, BoxGroup, Bling Capital, plus 100+ tech executives. Span's developer-intelligence platform tracks engineer time and AI code-editor usage and detects AI-generated code; customers include Ramp, Vanta, Intercom and Braze.

data.similarity_reason: Developer-tooling startup serving engineering teams: Testkube is a continuous testing platform that automates test execution and quality checks in Kubernetes-native CI/CD workflows, comparable to automated code review for engineering teams.
data.partner_evidence: The release quotes 'Mike Triplett, Managing Director at Insight Partners,' commenting that Testkube is addressing the next big bottleneck in testing; the round was led by existing investors Ratmir Timashev and Insight Partners.
data.evidence_summary: On Sept 23, 2025 Testkube announced an $8M Series A led by existing investors Ratmir Timashev, co-founder of Veeam, and global software investor Insight Partners. Testkube is a NYC-based, Kubernetes-native continuous testing platform (a 2023 Kubeshop spin-off) that has powered 100M+ automated tests for customers including Cloudflare, Siemens, Adobe and Volvo. Insight's Mike Triplett is quoted as Managing Director. No per-investor cheque, stage tranche, or round amount split was disclosed.

data.similarity_reason: Like the target startup, Qodo builds automated/AI code review tooling for engineering teams: specialized agents review every pull request with full codebase context, enforce coding standards and govern AI-generated code across repos and IDEs.
data.geography: New York, USA (R&D in Tel Aviv, Israel)
data.partner_evidence: The 2026-03-30 GlobeNewswire release quotes 'Boaz Morris, Partner at Qumra Capital' commenting on Qodo's Series B, identifying him as the Qumra partner on the deal.
data.contact_evidence: Qodo's official Contact page provides a web form to reach the company about product, pricing or technical questions.
data.evidence_summary: Qodo announced on 2026-03-30 a $70M Series B led by Qumra Capital, bringing total capital raised to $120M, with participation from Maor Ventures, Phoenix Capital Partners, S Ventures, Square Peg, Susa Ventures, TLV Partners, Vine Ventures and angels Peter Welender (OpenAI) and Clara Shih (Meta). Qodo is an AI code review and governance platform used by Walmart, NVIDIA, Red Hat, Box, Intuit, Ford and Monday.com; the round scales enterprise operations and adds hiring in Tel Aviv.

data.partner_evidence: Swarmia's own announcement quotes 'Kristjan Laanemaa, Founding Partner at Karma Ventures', the lead investor, on the round.
